title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Missing… (CVE-2026-80272)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have a Missing Authorization vulnerability (CWE-862). This flaw allows an attacker with local access to perform unauthorized actions and potentially expose information. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.1.
